run_bench_serving: run serving benchmark on an sglang server with configurable prompts, request rate, and input/output lengths
run_bench_one_batch: run one-batch latency benchmark for an sglang model and return prefill latency, decode throughput, and decode latency
popen_launch_server: launch an sglang server process with automatic device detection, offline cache validation, and health check retry
run_embeddings_benchmark: run embeddings API benchmark with configurable batch size, input tokens, and warmup support
run_score_benchmark: run score/reranker API benchmark with configurable batch size, query and item token counts, and warmup support
